title: AURORA: Adaptive Uncertainty-Aware Radiative Observation and Ranging Architecture
subtitle: Toward Information-Driven Adaptive Multimodal Sensing

sections.title: Research hypotheses
draftBullets: H1: Under a fixed measurement budget, the value of a given observation depends on the current state estimate and its uncertainty.
H2: An uncertainty-aware strategy can identify information deficits before selecting its next observation.
H3: Complementary physical observables can reduce surface-atmosphere ambiguity that a single modality cannot resolve.
H4: Any advantage of adaptive selection is condition-dependent and must be demonstrated against strong fixed and random baselines.
